From DjotV Require Import Invariants Uniformity ListUniformity InlineScan.
Check hard_wrap_one_para.
Print Assumptions hard_wrap_one_para.
Check hard_wrap_para_then_rest.
Print Assumptions hard_wrap_para_then_rest.
Check quote_uniformity.
Print Assumptions quote_uniformity.
Check list_uniformity.
Print Assumptions list_uniformity.
Check prefix_determinism.
Print Assumptions prefix_determinism.
Check no_future_line_dependence.
Print Assumptions no_future_line_dependence.
Check classify_inlines_locality.
Print Assumptions classify_inlines_locality.
Check iscan_str_no_reread.
Print Assumptions iscan_str_no_reread.

hard_wrap_one_para
     : forall (T : InlineTable.dtable) (K : Step.bconfig),
       wrap_neutral K ->
       forall (a : String.string) (ls : list String.string),
       Line.classify a = Line.KText ->
       List.forallb Strings.nonblank ls = true ->
       Step.parse_lines (a :: ls) (Step.PPara nil) =
       (Ast.mk
          (Ast.Para
             (para_inlines (ListDef.map Strings.drop_leading_ws (a :: ls))))
        :: nil)%list
Closed under the global context
hard_wrap_para_then_rest
     : forall (T : InlineTable.dtable) (K : Step.bconfig),
       wrap_neutral K ->
       forall (a : String.string) (ls : list String.string)
         (b : String.string) (rest : list String.string),
       Line.classify a = Line.KText ->
       List.forallb Strings.nonblank ls = true ->
       Strings.is_blank b = true ->
       Step.parse_lines ((a :: ls) ++ b :: rest) (Step.PPara nil) =
       (Ast.mk
          (Ast.Para
             (para_inlines (ListDef.map Strings.drop_leading_ws (a :: ls))))
        :: Step.parse_lines rest (Step.PPara nil))%list
Closed under the global context
quote_uniformity
     : forall (l : String.string) (lines : list String.string),
       Step.quote_header l = None ->
       Step.parse_lines
         (ListDef.map
            (fun x : String.string =>
             String.append
               (String.String
                  (Ascii.Ascii false true true true true true false false)
                  (String.String
                     (Ascii.Ascii false false false false false true false
                        false)
                     String.EmptyString))
               x)
            (l :: lines))
         (Step.PPara nil) =
       (Ast.mk
          (Ast.BlockQuote (Step.parse_lines (l :: lines) (Step.PPara nil)))
        :: nil)%list
where
?T : [ |- InlineTable.dtable]
?K : [ |- Step.bconfig]
Closed under the global context
list_uniformity
     : forall (m0 : Line.marker) (sp : Ast.list_spacing)
         (L0 : list String.string)
         (tail : list (Line.marker * list String.string)),
       Line.marker_ok m0 = true ->
       items_ok m0 ((m0, L0) :: tail) = true ->
       Step.parse_lines
         (list_lines sp (ListDef.map litem_lines ((m0, L0) :: tail)))
         (Step.PPara nil) =
       (Step.marker_list_checked m0
          (list_spacing_of sp (ListDef.map snd ((m0, L0) :: tail)))
          (ListDef.map
             (fun it : Line.marker * list String.string =>
              Line.mk_check (fst it))
             ((m0, L0) :: tail))
          (ListDef.map
             (fun it : Line.marker * list String.string =>
              Step.parse_lines (snd it) (Step.PPara nil))
             ((m0, L0) :: tail))
        :: nil)%list
where
?T : [ |- InlineTable.dtable]
?K : [ |- Step.bconfig]
Closed under the global context
prefix_determinism
     : forall (xs ys : list String.string) (st : Step.pstate),
       Step.parse_lines (xs ++ ys) st =
       (committed xs st ++ Step.parse_lines ys (snd (run_lines xs st)))%list
where
?T : [ |- InlineTable.dtable]
?K : [ |- Step.bconfig]
Closed under the global context
no_future_line_dependence
     : forall (xs ys ys' : list String.string) (st : Step.pstate),
       ListDef.firstn (length (committed xs st))
         (Step.parse_lines (xs ++ ys) st) =
       ListDef.firstn (length (committed xs st))
         (Step.parse_lines (xs ++ ys') st)
where
?T : [ |- InlineTable.dtable]
?K : [ |- Step.bconfig]
Closed under the global context
classify_inlines_locality
     : forall (a b : inline_env) (l : list String.string),

where
?T : [ |- InlineTable.dtable]
